content: Implemented workspace bar in lua/bar/init.lua; tests run init.lua in wasmoon (Lua 5.4) against SDK MockHost 4f9f1ba7; 36 tests incl. per-column Core workspaceline parity; just check green. Host gaps: no band click routing in Core, fg/bg/bold not painted, no exclusive zone, empty band keeps stacking index, mounts activation-only.

PR bar#2 merged as 558271bb (squash, --admin per owner). CI Quality gates green. CodeRabbit is not installed on plugin repos (no bot comments on bar#2 or prior plugin PRs), nothing to apply. Issue #1 closed. No independent reviewer dispatched by this subagent (harness rule); commander to review post-merge.

Registry pin: not changed. origin/main bitty-plugins pins official plugins as submodules and has no bar entry (no registry/official/bar.toml, no plugins/bar gitlink), so there is no pin to bump; adding bar is full onboarding (capability review by a reviewer, docs page-set alignment, registry entry + manifest_hash, submodule) and collides with the uncommitted local registry-pins.toml submodule-removal migration in the bitty-plugins checkout. Follow-up for the bitty-plugins commander.

Post-merge review bar#2 (558271bb) by bar-reviewer: NEEDS-FIX. Blocker (confirmed): truncate_chars gmatch pattern with lone bytes 128-191 raises invalid utf-8 on phodopus (pattern.to_str in stdlib/string/patterns.rs, rev 1653c51f), so the bar cannot render on the real host; rewrite with string.byte/string.sub. Also: tests run wasmoon Lua 5.4 not phodopus (add phodopus gate); args_schema id should be integer (non-blocking); merged with no review/CodeRabbit output. Parity model, manifest, SDK surface, supply chain, hardcoded values OK. Review doc: recording/semantic-review/2026-10-02-170042-bar-pr-2.md

Fix implemented: M.segments uses row.id (stable seq) instead of index; README and code comment updated to stable-id; reference model core-workspaceline.ts now renders slot.seq with seq carried from row.id; bar.test.ts expectations updated to stable labels plus new close-first/close-middle stable-seq test. Gates: bun test 37 pass; just check green. Negative control: old index code fails 10/37, fixed passes 37/37.

Implemented Waybar-like workspace capsules in ctx-0001 worktree: stable numeric-id ordering, active/occupied/attention textual markers, complete-capsule UTF-8 byte bounding, stable-id inactive click bindings, top/bottom edge validation with left/right fallback documented from host evidence, and generic plugin TOML configuration README guidance. just check passes with 39 tests. Worktree remains uncommitted/unpushed.

Independent review: APPROVE for the bar plugin implementation scope against bitty #2178 and the current host boundary. Evidence: `just check` passes (manifest lint 0 errors/0 warnings, Lua parse passes, Bun 39 tests pass); capabilities are limited to ui.rich, workspace.read, and workspace.control; workspace.list exposes only bounded identity/structure fields (no terminal content); read and focus grants remain separated; rendering uses the SDK-v1 Text/Row/on_click/theme-token surface; workspace events re-render from list; stale, active, malformed, and non-integer focus targets fail closed; stable numeric IDs and complete-capsule UTF-8 bounds are covered by tests. Review finding: CONTRACT-SYNC, not an implementation blocker: README.md documents `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/bitty/plugins/bitty-terminal.bar.toml` and effective show/edge/show_single/name_max_chars settings, but bitty-plugin.toml currently declares no settings schema and the current restricted TOML loader does not yet make these keys effective. Core CTX-1294 and bitty-plugins issue #90 own the declared-key/restricted-Lua settings contract; do not add restricted Lua here. Current host limitations (band click routing, vertical bands, overlay/inset behavior, fallback/loader integration) remain documented and belong to Core/loader work. No other blocking findings.

Independent review: APPROVE for the complete uncommitted bar capsule diff against origin/main and issue #2178. Evidence: just check passes (manifest 0 errors/0 warnings, Lua parse/control pass, Bun 39 tests pass); git diff --check passes. Stable positive numeric workspace IDs are rendered and sorted deterministically by ID; inactive capsules bind clicks with args { id }, active/stale/unknown/non-integer targets fail closed, and the focus command re-lists before enqueueing. bitty.workspace.list is the only observation source and the pinned SDK bounds it to 16 identity/structure rows with names capped at 32 chars; no terminal content is read. workspace.read and workspace.control remain separate manifest grants, with UI gated by ui.rich. Rendering uses complete [id:name] Text capsules, active * plus accent/background/bold styling, occupied +, attention !, single-space separators, numeric ordering, UTF-8-safe name handling, and complete-capsule 1024-byte clipping. Empty and single-workspace behavior, top/bottom edge behavior, live workspace/config event updates, UTF-8 bounds, clicks, and capability gates are covered. Current Core limitation wording is accurate: band click routing and overlay/inset/loader integration remain host boundaries; left/right are accepted storage/API slots but are not currently painted vertical bands, so the plugin rejects them and falls back to bottom. Follow-up only, not a blocker and not changed: README documents generic TOML settings/effective keys while bitty-plugin.toml has no settings schema and the restricted loader does not yet make these keys effective; synchronize under CTX-1294 / bitty-plugins#90. No security/capability or UX regression found beyond that contract-sync item.

Resolved integration is staged but deliberately uncommitted and unpushed for commander review.

Independent staged-diff review: APPROVE for the PX-0014-integrated CTX-0001 capsule presentation against origin/main and issue #2178. Reviewed git diff --cached origin/main (10 files, 253 insertions, 132 deletions): only capsule rendering, workspace fixtures/expected text, and related README/reference updates are staged; Phase B modules, provider negotiation and required capability heads, settings declarations, device/sensor/audio behavior, and bar#17 chained one-shot timer behavior remain present and covered. Capsule checks: stable numeric IDs sorted deterministically; inactive complete Text capsules bind focus by stable id; active/stale/unknown/non-integer focus fails closed; workspace.list remains the bounded identity/structure observation source; workspace.read, workspace.control, and ui.rich stay separate; active accent/background/bold, occupied +, attention ! markers; UTF-8-safe name truncation and complete-capsule 1024-byte clipping; lifecycle/config reload behavior preserved; current Core limitations remain accurately documented. Evidence: just check passes with manifest 0 errors/0 warnings, Lua parser/control pass, Bun 196 tests pass; git diff --cached --check passes. No blocking findings.
